title: Deductible Options and Deductible Waiver Amounts, HomeGuard Packages
content:
Rate manual, HomeGuard Homeowners Policy: the deductible choices each package may be written with, the dollar floor under the percentage wind/hail deductible, and the occurrence amount from which a package waives its deductible.

## Deductible table

| Package | All-other-perils deductible options (USD) | Wind/hail deductible options (percent of Coverage A) | Wind/hail deductible minimum (USD) | Deductible waiver threshold (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 1000, 2500, 5000 | 1 or 2 | 1000 | 0 (no waiver) |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 500, 1000, 2500, 5000 | 1 or 2 | 1000 | 0 (no waiver) |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 500, 1000, 2500, 5000 | 1 or 2 | 1000 | 0 (no waiver) |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 500, 1000, 2500, 5000 | 1 or 2 | 1000 | 0 (no waiver) |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000 | 1 or 2 | 2500 | 100000 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | 2500, 5000, 10000, 25000 | 1, 2 or 5 | 2500 | 50000 |

## Terms of the table

1. **All-other-perils deductible.** The declarations carry one of the amounts listed for the package; no other amount is available on that package.
2. **Wind/hail deductible percentage.** The declarations carry one of the percentages listed for the package, applied to the Coverage A limit. Only HomeGuard HO-5 Signature offers 5 percent.
3. **Wind/hail deductible minimum.** This is the dollar floor under the percentage wind/hail deductible: the wind/hail deductible is never a smaller dollar figure than the package's minimum.
4. **Deductible waiver threshold.** This is the covered loss amount per occurrence at or above which the deductible is waived. A threshold of 0 means the package has no waiver. Only HomeGuard HO-5 Premier (100000) and HomeGuard HO-5 Signature (50000) carry a waiver.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

The inputs below are hypothetical and serve only to show how the floor and the waiver threshold read.

- *Floor reached.* A HomeGuard HO-5 Premier policy with a hypothetical Coverage A of 150000 and a 1 percent wind/hail deductible: 1 percent of 150000 is 1500, which is below the package's 2500 floor, so the wind/hail deductible is 2500.
- *Floor not reached.* A HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced policy with a hypothetical Coverage A of 400000 and a 2 percent wind/hail deductible: 2 percent of 400000 is 8000, which is above the 1000 floor, so the wind/hail deductible is 8000.
- *Waiver boundary.* On HomeGuard HO-5 Signature a hypothetical occurrence with a covered loss amount of exactly 50000 reaches the threshold and the deductible is waived; a covered loss amount of 49999.99 does not reach it.
- *No waiver.* On HomeGuard HO-3 Premier the threshold is 0, so no occurrence amount, however large, waives the deductible.
